primaryDecision: Reconstruct challenge, failure, recovery and mastery as source-traceable derived practical views over frozen GDF2 contracts and existing Game/World/evaluation/Skill sources. Stabilize no Difficulty scalar, no universal Failure record, no universal Recovery object and no Mastered boolean. Current Station Zero supplies direct consumers for challenge comparison and failure debrief, while mastery remains a conditional claim surface rather than a current runtime state.

nullModelResults.N1_scalar_difficulty_is_enough: FALSIFIED. Current matched 14-vs-20 Turn, 18-profile strategy, topology, pressure and objective-condition studies establish multiple challenge properties whose ordering changes with target, condition and projection. A scalar may remain a local UI label only when its projection/weighting/scope is explicit.
nullModelResults.N2_one_failure_status_is_enough: FALSIFIED. Objective, faction, mission, Team task and provider/process failures coexist and can disagree on the same history. Failure must remain criterion/scope/horizon qualified.
nullModelResults.N3_one_recovery_concept_is_enough: FALSIFIED. Technical recover(runId), gameplay retrieve/rescue verbs and post-outcome pursuit continuation are independently variable and already coexist in the current repo.
nullModelResults.N4_system_mastery_can_remain_only_produc: PARTIALLY_SURVIVES_FOR_CURRENT_IMPLEMENTATION_BUT_FALSIFIED_AS_GENERAL_TOOLING_RULE. Current runtime needs no mastery persistence, but any actual mastery claim requires scoped SkillProfile/probe/currentness/attribution evidence. Stabilize conditional derived views; do not add a runtime mastery state.

ChallengeAssessmentView.purpose: Answer one declared challenge/difficulty question without inventing an intrinsic scalar content property.
laws: ProjectionKind must be explicit when correctness matters
Synthetic challenge evidence != Human experienced difficulty by identity
Human-friendly easy/hard labels are lossy presentation, not source truth

ChallengeComparisonView.purpose: Compare two or more challenge conditions while making changed/held-fixed dimensions and projection type explicit.
laws: One projection can improve while another worsens
Population pass-rate reversal does not identify intrinsic difficulty
Assist effect does not imply inverse difficulty
Matched comparison must expose what changed and what remained fixed

FailureAssessmentView.purpose: State whether a declared criterion was satisfied, partially satisfied, not satisfied or remains unresolved over an explicit scope/horizon, while retaining authority/currentness and distinguishing neighboring technical/workflow failures.

OutcomeAttributionView.purpose: Expose evidence-supported contributors and unresolved alternatives for an outcome/failure without collapsing causation, responsibility, blame or Skill deficit.

PursuitContinuationView.purpose: Represent authoritative post-outcome continuation options while avoiding the overloaded word Recovery as a semantic source.
laws: Terminality is derived relative to pursuit/horizon/continuation

RecoveryCostView.purpose: Compare continuation/recovery consequences under an explicit purpose or weighting without inventing a universal FailureSeverity scalar.

MasteryClaimView.purpose: Assess an explicitly requested mastery claim over SkillProfile without turning mastery into a state boolean.

MasteryEvidenceView.purpose: Show what evidence actually supports or fails to support a MasteryClaimView, including saturation, independence, transfer, assistance and attribution caveats.
laws: Evidence sample may support but not define the mastery criterion circularly
Easy saturated success can be weak mastery evidence
Transfer evidence is required only when transfer is claimed
Retention evidence is required only when retention is claimed
Assisted performance supports the declared joint/assisted target unless Human-independent transfer is separately shown
Social rank/credential != capability mastery by identity

FailureDebriefView.purpose: Provide an understandable post-run/post-pursuit packet that separates what failed, why the pursuit ended, evidence-supported contributors, tradeoffs/near-misses and what continuation remains.
laws: Terminal reason must be labeled separately from contributor/cause
Generated summary cannot upgrade unresolved attribution
Debrief may be lossy only when source drill-down survives

ChallengeFailureMasteryDiagnostic.purpose: Detect scalar, scope, recovery-domain, attribution and mastery-overclaim collapses in authoring, UI, Agent context and analytics.

StationZeroFactionOutcome.finding: pending|victory|partial|failure is valid faction-level evaluation truth, not a universal Failure ontology.

StationZeroObjectiveStatus.finding: active|completed|failed is objective-local and may coexist with different faction outcomes.

OperationDebrief.finding: Already aggregates terminal reason, objective statuses/progress and focus turns. It proves product value for debrief while also requiring terminal reason to stay distinct from causal contributor.

MissionControlEndState.finding: Mission failed plus terminal condition is useful presentation, but the terminal condition is not a complete failure cause.

FactionOutcomeReason.finding: Currently set to turn_limit or no_active_combatants. Correct as encounter termination reason; unsafe as universal causal attribution.

ActionFeedback.finding: executed/interrupted/invalidated/contested/no_effect guides retry/adaptation but one failed action does not determine pursuit failure.

TechnicalRecoverRunId.finding: Verifies/reconstructs authoritative persisted state after crash/response loss; keep separate from GDF2 continuation.

GameplayRecoverLabels.finding: recover-research-core/recover-civilian are domain verbs unrelated to post-failure continuation by identity.

FixtureStrategyEvaluator.finding: 18 matched objective/posture/formation profiles with outcome vectors support query-specific challenge/viability comparisons without scalar Difficulty.

ProductValueCounterfactuals.finding: turn budget, topology, pressure, doctrine and placement counterfactuals already expose changed/held-fixed dimensions and causal outcome differences.

ProductSystemMastery.finding: Keep prose. Use conditional MasteryClaim/Evidence views only when an actual capability/mastery claim is evaluated.

UnderstandableFailurePrinciple.finding: Product acceptance explicitly requires a failed Run to identify an understandable contributor; GPR7 provides evidence-bounded attribution semantics without claiming blame or skill deficit.

safeCurrentConsumption: Use GPR7 distinctions when extending Station Zero OperationDebrief so terminal reason, failed criteria and evidence-bounded contributors remain separate.
Treat existing fixture/product-value evaluators as ChallengeAssessment/Comparison evidence substrates rather than creating Difficulty state.
Keep technical recover(runId) names and semantics local; disambiguate documentation/API context rather than renaming solely for ontology aesthetics.
Keep existing faction/objective/task/provider statuses; compose derived views when needed rather than migrate them into a generic Failure schema.
Keep System mastery as product language until a real research/UI claim needs MasteryClaimView.
notAdmitted: automatic individual skill attribution from team outcome
Human experienced-difficulty inference from synthetic/product telemetry

nextRoute.rule: After GPR7, perform another practical residual/coverage decision. Do not assume GPR8. GDF0-GDF3 remain frozen absent a concrete reopen condition.
